authorization: Standing human authorization for independently proven unreachable coverage cases; no threshold/data/algorithm changes.
errorDomain: For a nonfailed entry status, actual res_load has only three explicit positive-error assignments: illegal null/empty names or missing-file access. init_entry normalizes names and converts loading errors to a negative fallback warning. Its only remaining positive-error source is getPoolEntry validation, contradicted by the fixed pool tuple and the complete original native package witness. Induction over finite alias/pool recursion yields only success/warning; host allocation exceptions are not native null/status returns. Incoming failures remain handled and tested at their actual entry points.

scopes.reason: res_load writes only illegal-argument/file-access errors, never memory status; failed incoming status already returns before loading.
Validated immutable pool exists, is non-bogus, has isPoolBundle and never recursively uses the pool.
After the same successful pool load, the status cannot be a failure.

Synchronous private Map insertion has no callbacks/concurrency; all53 default-package file aliases are acyclic and cannot reinsert an in-flight filename. Native race/other-package alias behavior remains outside the binding.
The actual pool entry is present/non-bogus/isPoolBundle; its tuple and native package checksums are validated.

Default-locale search preserves the same non-memory status domain, including unknown/default/root names.

Final root search has a fresh nonfailed status and cannot produce memory status.
Final root search necessarily finds the actual root bundle.

Pure local flow sets hasRealData=true whenever r becomes non-null; this arm is entered only from the non-null-r else path.
Successful function entry and all represented operations leave status nonfailed; retain its guard, normal return and the separate unreachable final return.

The same direct-open path has no represented source of a positive status.

init_entry returns the final non-alias target; fAlias is assigned only during construction before cache insertion. Its adopted target therefore cannot itself have an alias. Retain the while condition; exclude only its unreachable advance statement.

limits: Concrete synchronous default-package backend and valid original cache ownership. Native OOM, concurrent insertion, external packages, corrupted mapped resources/private entries and invalid refcount lifetimes are not certified. Existing native alias/self-parent observations are preserved; no general upstream race/alias guard is declared erroneous.
